caption:
The cave paintings of Lascaux are about 17,000 years old.

Discovered in 1940 inside a cave complex in southwestern France, these Palaeolithic artworks depict bulls, horses, and deer. Mineral pigments applied to limestone walls have remained preserved underground for roughly 17,000 years.
